searchText: I think in the past EIPs without champion never made it into a hardfork. There are sometimes rescopings of the forks and a champion is needed to push back against the removal of their EIP. With no champion present, there is no pushback and the EIP just gets taken out, having wasted time of the teams that worked on it already. This has happened as recetly as Fusaka. Looks like <@399309815517544451> & <@845691100072509460> from Prysm may be willing to champion 6SF for H* as they have already done work prototyping it. Would that be a fair statement? https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1446193388893372448 once this has been doublechecked, can we get this pr'd into the meta EIP? then we'd have an easy way to see what decisions were made from call to call (happy to open the PR once i hear that the list above is correct) I am interested in bringing some refactors into Prysm, which I believe would be a meaningful improvement. Nothing more, nothing less.
